title: Perform Daily Maintenance Checklist for Tipper (Operator Station, Chute, Stacklights, Guards, QR Codes)
summary: Complete the daily inspection items for the OptiSweep tipper system to confirm key operator-station and physical components are in acceptable condition.
when_to_use: Use this daily checklist procedure to perform routine operator-station and physical inspections of the tipper system components: Operator Station controller, Operator Station chute, stacklights, guards/attaching hardware, and QR codes on the floor and racks.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the daily visual/physical inspection checklist items and record results on the Daily Maintenance Checklist form.
safety_notes: If any checklist item fails (controller damage, chute debris, non-operational stacklights, loose/unsafe guards, damaged/peeling QR codes), stop the checklist and escalate per site maintenance process.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper operator station controller, chute, stacklights, guards, and QR codes on the floor and racks

access_required: Physical access to the tipper operator station controller, chute, stacklights, guards, and QR codes on the floor and racks
external_references: Daily Maintenance Checklist form (photocopiable) referenced in the manual section 7.1.3

visual_references.description: Labeled photograph of the OptiSweep operator station showing the internal layout (tipper, chute, stacklight, plastic curtain, operator station HMI, push-buttons, rotary station). Useful for identifying the components referenced by the daily checklist.
Diagram of the Controller PCA and its mounting box within the OptiSweep tipper station. Useful for understanding what the “Operator Station controller” refers to visually.

steps.title: Record inspection metadata on the Daily Maintenance Checklist form
steps.purpose: Ensure the inspection is traceable and tied to the correct unit and inspector.
steps.instruction: On the Daily Maintenance Checklist form, record the Inspection Date, Inspected By, and Unit Inspected.
steps.expected_result: The form has entries for Inspection Date, Inspected By, and Unit Inspected.
steps.healthy_condition: All three fields are completed (no blanks).
steps.failure_condition: Any of the three fields are missing or incomplete.

actions.label: Fill checklist header fields
actions.exact_action: Record Inspection Date, Inspected By, and Unit Inspected on the Daily Maintenance Checklist form.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.1.3 DAILY MAINTENANCE CHECKLIST: Inspect Operator Station controller for damage; ensure Operator Station chute is free of debris; verify stacklights are operational; inspect the guards and verify attaching hardware is secure; inspect all QR codes on the floor for damage or peeling; inspect all QR codes on the racks for damage or peeling.

steps.title: Inspect the Operator Station controller for damage
steps.purpose: Detect physical damage to the controller referenced by the daily checklist.
steps.instruction: Visually inspect the Operator Station controller for damage.
steps.expected_result: You can mark the checklist item as passing because no damage is found on the Operator Station controller.
steps.healthy_condition: No visible damage is present on the Operator Station controller.
steps.failure_condition: Damage is found on the Operator Station controller.

actions.label: Check controller condition
actions.exact_action: Inspect the Operator Station controller for damage.

stop_or_escalate_if: If controller damage is found, stop the checklist and escalate per site maintenance process.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Daily Maintenance Checklist includes: □ Inspect the Operator Station controller for damage.

steps.title: Ensure the Operator Station chute is free of debris
steps.purpose: Confirm the chute is clear so operation is not impeded by debris.
steps.instruction: Inspect the Operator Station chute and ensure it is free of debris.
steps.expected_result: You can mark the checklist item as passing because no debris is present in the Operator Station chute.
steps.healthy_condition: The Operator Station chute is clear of debris.
steps.failure_condition: Debris is present in the Operator Station chute.

actions.label: Check chute cleanliness
actions.exact_action: Ensure Operator Station chute is free of debris.

stop_or_escalate_if: If debris is found, stop the checklist and escalate per site maintenance process.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Daily Maintenance Checklist includes: □ Ensure Operator Station chute is free of debris.

steps.title: Verify stacklights are operational
steps.purpose: Confirm stacklights function as expected for operator signaling.
steps.expected_result: You can mark the checklist item as passing because the stacklights are operational.
steps.healthy_condition: Stacklights are operational (functional as observed during the inspection).
stop_or_escalate_if: If stacklights are non-operational, stop the checklist and escalate per site maintenance process.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Daily Maintenance Checklist includes: □ Verify stacklights are operational.

steps.title: Inspect guards and verify attaching hardware is secure
steps.purpose: Ensure guards are secure and attaching hardware is not loose.
steps.instruction: Inspect the guards and verify attaching hardware is secure.
steps.expected_result: You can mark the checklist item as passing because guards are secure and attaching hardware is secure.
steps.healthy_condition: Guards are secure and attaching hardware is secure.
steps.failure_condition: Guards are loose or attaching hardware is not secure.

actions.label: Check guard security
actions.exact_action: Inspect the guards and verify attaching hardware is secure.

stop_or_escalate_if: If guards are loose/unsafe or attaching hardware is not secure, stop the checklist and escalate per site maintenance process.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Daily Maintenance Checklist includes: □ Inspect the guards and verify attaching hardware is secure.

steps.title: Inspect all QR codes on the floor for damage or peeling
steps.purpose: Ensure floor QR codes are readable and intact.
steps.instruction: Inspect all QR codes on the floor for damage or peeling.

stop_or_escalate_if: If any floor QR code is damaged or peeling, stop the checklist and escalate per site maintenance process.

success_criteria: All checklist items can be marked as passing: no damage found on the Operator Station controller, chute is clear of debris, stacklights function, guards and attaching hardware are secure, and all floor/rack QR codes show no damage or peeling.
healthy_conditions: Operator Station controller shows no damage
Operator Station chute is free of debris
Guards are secure and attaching hardware is secure
All floor QR codes show no damage or peeling
All rack QR codes show no damage or peeling
failure_conditions: Damage found on the Operator Station controller
Debris present in the Operator Station chute
Floor QR codes damaged or peeling
Rack QR codes damaged or peeling
escalation_guidance: If any checklist item fails (controller damage, chute debris, non-operational stacklights, loose/unsafe guards, damaged/peeling QR codes), stop the checklist and escalate per site maintenance process.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: 7.1.3 DAILY MAINTENANCE CHECKLIST: Inspect Operator Station controller for damage; ensure Operator Station chute is free of debris; verify stacklights are operational; inspect the guards and verify attaching hardware is secure; inspect all QR codes on the floor for damage or peeling; inspect all QR codes on the racks for damage or peeling.

missing_details: The manual checklist states to “Verify stacklights are operational” but the packet does not include an explicit definition of what “operational” looks like (e.g., which colors/states or how to test). The operator should use their on-site observation criteria for operational functionality until a stacklight test/observable criteria is provided in the source materials.
